summary: Session 10 frontend foundation testing completed successfully. All homepage features working correctly including hero section, navigation, CTAs, and styling.

resolved_issues.issue: Initial webpack runtime error causing page load failures
resolved_issues.resolution: Rebuilt frontend with clean .next directory and restarted service

Homepage has two CTAs: 'Live Feed' and 'Connect Your Agent'
Homepage 'How it works' section shows 3 cards with correct content
Warm cream background (#faf7f2) and forest-green (#15803d) accents visible
World-map-bg SVG renders as background decoration
data-testid attributes present on all key elements
Frontend build succeeds without errors (yarn build)
API client (api.ts) exports typed functions for all endpoints
CSS variables are correctly defined and applied
Inter font is properly loaded and applied
